title: Kuwait-flagged VLCC KAZIMAH III hit in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: Kuwait-flagged VLCC KAZIMAH III was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on 1 October, starting a fire; crew reported safe.
